speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool consistency recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand these symptoms are concerning. Given the "drenching" nature of your night sweats and significant weight loss, have you experienced any fever or changes in your appetite? Also, have you noticed any skin changes, such as itching, or any lumps other than the supraclavicular area?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of drenching night sweats, significant weight loss, painless but fixed supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, and abdominal pain is highly suspicious for malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential, Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH), and ESR. REQUEST IMAGES: CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis.
